description: Returns one Quran verse by surah and ayah number: Tanzil Uthmani Arabic and Pickthall English, with citation. Quote the Arabic exactly; do not paraphrase either text.

locale.description: Translation locale; defaults to "en" (Pickthall). Urdu and Indonesian translations are not yet available: "ur" and "id" return Pickthall English with a note.
